description: Time range picker with from/to time inputs, optional swap button, duration display, and validation for invalid ranges where end is before start. Additive AllowOvernightRange treats End before Start as a night shift; Presentation Popup/Auto adopts TmTimePicker / TmTimeSelector with a shared CommitMode. Default Presentation=Segments keeps today's two TmTimeInput DOM.

parameters.name: HourCycle
parameters.description: 12-hour versus 24-hour clock forwarded to both ends (TmTimeInput in Segments, TmTimePicker in Popup/Auto). Default Auto follows Culture.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve HourCycle.Auto. Null uses CurrentCulture.

parameters.name: AllowOvernightRange
parameters.description: When true, End before Start is a valid range that crosses midnight (night shifts). Defaults to false so today's same-day comparison is unchanged.

parameters.name: Presentation
parameters.description: How each end presents. Default Segments keeps today's two TmTimeInput DOM. Popup/Auto render two TmTimePickers that open TmTimeSelector in a dialog (sheet on a mobile viewport).

parameters.name: CommitMode
parameters.description: Shared commit mode for both ends when Presentation is Popup or Auto; ignored by Segments. Default Auto: a sheet holds a draft until Done; a popover commits live.

parameters.name: MinuteStep
parameters.description: Minute step forwarded to both ends when Presentation is Popup or Auto; ignored by Segments. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: EnableSwipe
parameters.description: Forwards TmTimePicker.EnableSwipe to both overlay ends when Presentation is Popup or Auto; ignored by Segments. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: EnforceStep
parameters.description: When true, an off-step bound value is marked invalid and never rewritten. Popup/Auto only; ignored by Segments. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders both ends read-only and hides the swap button. Never assigned inside the component. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Layout forwarded to both overlay pickers. Auto follows the viewport cascade.

parameters.name: StartLabel
parameters.description: Visible label of the start group. Falls back to localized TmTimeRangePicker_From.

parameters.name: EndLabel
parameters.description: Visible label of the end group. Falls back to localized TmTimeRangePicker_To.
